item.title: Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere could be an example of how Final Fantasy could handle its mythology going forward.
item.author: invalid@example.com (Iluminado_Horn)
item.dc:creator: Iluminado_Horn
item.content:encoded: Each game will have its own mythology and rules, but in the background there's a whole narrative being created, something much more cosmic that will affect all these "worlds." Do you think this is a good idea for dealing with the lore of Final Fantasy? I don't know about you, but I think Final Fantasy can be something separate in each game, but there should be a connection between the games, even if it's on a cosmic plane, a greater threat. I'd like to see something like that, wouldn't you?
